prompt:
Task / size class:
Loop 100 — SHORT minimal-port GitHub workflow observation task.

Goal:
Add only the smallest pure GitHub Actions workflow-run status/conclusion -> Observed Signal check-state mapper. Do not design the complete PR/check observation subsystem.

Upstream / accepted source:
- automation/command_bus/runtime_transition_status_dispatch.py
  Existing accepted code validates GitHub workflow run status as one of queued / in_progress / completed and requires a string conclusion only when completed. It treats terminal success separately from terminal non-success.
- Existing GitHub Actions API readbacks already expose .status and .conclusion. No new transport is needed in this task.

Small component to reuse:
Only that existing workflow-run status/conclusion vocabulary and terminal-success distinction.

Existing local destination:
- automation/command_bus/signal_observed_github.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_signal_observed_github.py

Allowed changed paths — EXACTLY these two files.

Required behavior:
Implement one small pure function, for example map_github_workflow_run_to_observed_check(status, conclusion), with no network/file/GitHub calls.

Mappings:
- status="queued", conclusion=None -> VERIFYING
- status="in_progress", conclusion=None -> VERIFYING
- status="completed", conclusion="success" -> PASS
- status="completed", conclusion="failure" -> FAIL
- status="completed" with any other conclusion, including cancelled, skipped, neutral, timed_out, action_required, stale, startup_failure, None or non-string -> UNKNOWN
- any unsupported/malformed status, including None, empty, uppercase variants or non-string -> UNKNOWN
- nonterminal queued/in_progress with any non-None conclusion -> UNKNOWN

Do not infer PASS from session completion, PR presence, timestamps, silence or mergeability.
Do not create a generic provider/check framework.
Do not select/filter workflow runs or bind a PR head in this task; exact-head binding is the next separate Signal component.
Do not import durable runtime/owner/authority/registry/collector modules.

Tests:
Directly assert the four positive mappings and representative UNKNOWN cases above. Keep tests simple/table-driven if useful.

Do NOT:
- modify runtime_transition_status_dispatch.py
- modify workflows/readback transports
- modify signal_observed_jules.py
- modify Control Tower registry/schemas/snapshot/runtime code
- modify Issue #33/status publisher
- add docs/checkpoints/plan files
- add dependencies
- add speculative abstractions/features
- run provider/model/API/network calls
- Merge/rebase/force push/delete branches

Stop condition:
If this tiny mapper cannot fit in the two allowed files without broad redesign, STOP and report the incompatibility instead of expanding scope.

Validation:
python -m unittest automation.command_bus.tests.test_signal_observed_github -v
python -m unittest discover -v automation/command_bus/tests
python -m compileall -q automation/command_bus
git diff --check

Mandatory path fence:
Final changed-file set must equal exactly:
- automation/command_bus/signal_observed_github.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_signal_observed_github.py

Publication:
Publish the normal isolated Jules PR only if exact path fence and validations are green. Do not Merge.
